address: Virgen de la Victoria 5, Seville, 41011, Spain
bio: A restaurant with large glass windows and an unpretentious decor just a few metres from the former tobacco factory in the Los Remedios district of the city. Here, the focus is unashamedly on top-quality ingredients as chef Iván Valero is keen that the latter are showcased to the full without any unnecessary complication. On the menu, which harmoniously blends Andalucian and Basque influences, pride of place is given to select meats from across Spain, the best Galician seafood, and fish from the auction in Conil. A safe bet!...
